servers.description: One data service of the GBO demo ASIP mock: /<data service>/authsrc-api, one per authentic source. Port and base path fill in the server template of ETSI TS 119 478 Annex B; the base path is the ETSI default.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow of the authorization server, as clause 6.1.3 requires; Annex B leaves the security scheme out. Metadata: http://localhost:4021/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (RFC 8414). Access tokens are DPoP-bound JWTs (RFC 9449, RFC 9068): send them as `Authorization: DPoP <token>` with a DPoP proof for the request in the `DPoP` header.

X-JWS-Signature.description: Detached JWS (RFC 7515, appendix F) over the exact response body: ES256, certificate chain in x5c. Every verification result is signed or sealed under Article 9(4) of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1569 as amended by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1735; ETSI TS 119 478 does not define the form.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Challenge of RFC 9449 section 7.1 (scheme DPoP), with the error code of RFC 6750 section 3.1 or RFC 9449 when the request carried a token. Required on every 401 by RFC 6750 section 3 and RFC 9068 section 4.

500.description: The chain refused the ASIP's query to the authentic source: a fault in the deployment, not a missing value. Annex B lists no 500.

503.description: The authorization server's keys or the authentic source are unavailable: no access token can be validated, or the source gives no answer. Annex B lists no 503; this mock answers it rather than blame the client's token with 401, or report a missing value as Unknown.

400.description: Indicates that the submitted content was malformed (REQ-ASIP-6.1.2.2-06).

501.description: Indicates that the requested optional feature is not implemented (REQ-ASIP-6.1.2.2-06).
